notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons each turn.
description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Revolutionist.
When the Revolutionist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
